seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SLOT_INVALID: This stage's seeding map has an invalid position. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SOURCE_INVALID: This stage's seeding map points to a qualifier that doesn't exist. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS: This stage's seeding map points to a qualifier that exists in more than one place. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_RULES_MISSING: This stage has no seeding rules, or its generated fixtures no longer match them. Add seeding rules, or regenerate this stage's fixtures.
seeding.SEEDING_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE: The source stage isn't finished yet. Complete it before computing this proposal.
seeding.SEEDING_BESTNTH_UNEQUAL_POOLS: These groups have played different numbers of games, so their standings can't be compared yet.
seeding.SEEDING_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This stage's slots are already filled from a confirmed proposal.
seeding.SEEDING_PROPOSAL_STALE: Standings changed since this proposal was computed. Recompute it to see the current qualifiers.
seeding.proposalSuperseded: A newer proposal replaced this one. Review the new proposal and confirm it instead.
seeding.proposalRedrawn: Your tie pick re-drew round one, so your other changes no longer match the seats. Here is the new draft: make those changes again, then confirm.
seeding.SEEDING_EDIT_UNKNOWN_SLOT: One of your edits refers to a slot this proposal doesn't have. Recompute the proposal and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_TIE_UNRESOLVED: Resolve every tied slot before confirming — pick which entrant fills each one.
seeding.SEEDING_SLOT_DOUBLE_ASSIGNED: The same entrant is assigned to more than one slot. Fix your edits and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_ENTRANT_FOREIGN: One of the qualifying entrants no longer belongs to this division.
seeding.SEEDING_ENTRANT_WITHDRAWN: One of the qualifying entrants has withdrawn. Recompute the proposal to see who is left — their place in the draw stays empty.
seeding.SEEDING_SLOT_FOREIGN_FIXTURE: One of the destination slots belongs to a different stage. Recompute the proposal and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_FIXTURES_ALREADY_FILLED: One of the destination slots is already filled. Recompute the proposal to see what's left.
seeding.SEEDING_CARRY_SOURCE_INVALID: Carry-over needs a source stage with a points table — a league, group or Swiss stage. A knockout, ladder or Americano stage hands the next stage a finishing order rather than points, so there is nothing to carry over. Turn carry-over off for this stage, or source it from a league, group or Swiss stage.
seeding.SEEDING_NOTHING_TO_FILL: Nobody is left to seed into this stage — every qualifier has withdrawn. Recompute the proposal once the field is settled.
seeding.SEEDING_ROUNDLOSERS_DE_SOURCE: A double-elimination source can't feed a stage by round losers: its rounds are numbered separately in the winners' side, the losers' side and the grand final, so the cut would pick the wrong people. Take the stage's finishing places instead.
seeding.SEEDING_FIRSTLOSSES_DE_SOURCE: A double-elimination source can't feed a stage by first losses: a loser drops into the losers' side and may lose again, so there is no single first loss to wait for. Take the stage's finishing places instead.
seeding.SEEDING_BESTNTH_NO_SUPPLIER: No group has a player in place {rank} to compare (the largest has {available} after withdrawals), so the best-of-place qualifiers can't be picked. Lower the number of qualifiers, or change the format.
seeding.SEEDING_POOL_RESULTS_MISSING: Group {pool} is larger than the others, and its results are needed to compare its qualifier on the same number of matches. Refresh and try again; if it persists, contact support.
seeding.SEEDING_POOL_SEPARATION_IMPOSSIB: Round one can't avoid a same-group match: Group {pool} supplies {count} of the {entrants} qualifiers. Results are in, so the format can't be changed. Delete the stage they were going to play in; nothing in it has been played, and the group results stay.
seeding.SEEDING_PAGE_PLAYOFF_NEEDS_FOUR: A page playoff needs exactly 4 qualifiers, and this one has {entrants}. Results are in, so the format can't be changed. Delete the page playoff stage; nothing in it has been played, and the group results stay.
seeding.SEEDING_CROSS_POOL_DRAW_INVALID: The draw across the groups could not be made from these qualifiers ({reason}). Recompute the proposal; if it happens again, contact support.
seeding.SEEDING_CROSS_POOL_DRAW_TOO_LARG: A draw across the groups takes at most {maxPools} groups and {maxEntrants} qualifiers, and this one has {pools} groups and {entrants} qualifiers. Results are in, so the format can't be changed. Delete the stage they were going to play in; nothing in it has been played, and the group results stay.
seeding.SEEDING_TOP_N_ACROSS_GROUPS: This stage takes its top places from one table, but the stage before it is played in {pools} groups, so it would never be filled. Nothing was saved. To follow groups with a knockout, choose the Groups + Knockout format before the division starts.
seeding.SEEDING_QUALIFY_TOO_FEW: A knockout needs at least {min} qualifiers, and this count gives {qualified}. Nothing was saved. Pick {min} or more.
seeding.SEEDING_POOL_SEPARATION_IMPOSSIB: {entrants} qualifiers from {pools} groups can't be drawn so that no two players of one group meet in round one. Nothing was saved. Pick one of {options}.
No number of qualifiers from {pools} groups can be drawn so that no two players of one group meet in round one. Nothing was saved.
A page playoff takes exactly {size} qualifiers, and this has {entrants}. Nothing was saved. Pick {size}.
seeding.SEEDING_CROSS_POOL_DRAW_TOO_LARG: A draw across the groups takes at most {maxEntrants} qualifiers, and this asks for {entrants}. Nothing was saved. Pick {maxEntrants} or fewer.
A draw across the groups takes at most {maxPools} groups, and the stage before this one has {pools}. Nothing was saved, and no number of qualifiers changes that.
ladder.LADDER_ENTRANT_FOREIGN: Both players must be on this ladder. Refresh the page — the ladder may have changed since you opened it.
ladder.LADDER_ENTRANT_WITHDRAWN: That player has withdrawn from this division, so they can neither issue nor receive a challenge.
ladder.LADDER_CHALLENGE_NOT_UPWARD: You can only challenge someone ranked above you.
ladder.LADDER_CHALLENGE_OUT_OF_RANGE: Challenges reach at most {range} places up the ladder, counting only players who are still in the field.
save.err.unreachable: Couldn't reach Seazn. Check your connection and try again.
schedule.SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE_COMPETITION.be: This division's schedule starts before the competition opens on {startsOn}. Widen the competition dates, or bring the division inside them.
schedule.SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE_COMPETITION.af: This division's schedule ends after the competition closes on {endsOn}. Widen the competition dates, or bring the division inside them.
schedule.SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE_COMPETITION.bo: This division's schedule starts before the competition opens on {startsOn} and ends after it closes on {endsOn}. Widen the competition dates, or bring the division inside them.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.pin: Cannot remove a court that still holds pinned fixtures: {courtsDetail}. Unpin them or reschedule them before removing the court.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.fix: Cannot remove a court that still holds fixtures the schedule can't move: {courtsDetail}. They're already completed, so there's nothing to unpin or reschedule. To stop scheduling new matches on this court, archive it from the venue Directory instead of removing it here.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.inP: Cannot remove a court with a fixture still in play: {courtsDetail}. A live match can't be unpinned, rescheduled, or archived away — wait for it to finish, then try again.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.mix: Cannot remove a court that still holds fixtures the schedule can't move: {courtsDetail}. Unpin any pinned fixtures and wait for live matches to finish; once only completed fixtures remain, archive the court from the venue Directory instead of removing it here.
